_comments.fewPoints: With 30 or fewer recorded points the tail window is short and the curve shape labels are sensitive to noise.
_comments.headWindowFraction: Fraction of the finite points used as the head window. initial_loss is the median of this window.
_comments.tailWindowFraction: Fraction of the finite points used as the tail window. final_loss, tail_slope_per_1k, tail_improvement, and tail_cv use this window.
_comments.minWindowPoints: Lower limit of the number of points in the head and tail windows.
_comments.smoothingWindow: Number of points of the centered moving median used for min_loss, spike detection, and the smoothed curves of the figures. Near the ends the median is taken over the points that exist. min_loss is the lowest of the moving median, initial_loss, and final_loss.
_comments.minPoints: Runs with fewer recorded points of the metric are labeled insufficient_data and get no curve shape labels.
_comments.minCompletionRatio: Runs whose last step divided by the planned steps is below this value are labeled failed_or_killed.
_comments.divergingTailSlopePer1k: diverging when tail_slope_per_1k (slope of log(loss) per 1000 steps in the tail window) exceeds this value and tail_improvement is negative. Kept above 0 so that noise on a flat tail is not read as divergence.
_comments.convergingTailImprovement: converging when tail_improvement (1 - second half median / first half median of the tail window) exceeds this value and tail_slope_per_1k is negative.
_comments.plateauTailImprovement: plateau when tail_improvement is below this value and the run is not diverging.
_comments.spikeFactor: A point is a spike when it exceeds this multiple of the moving median.
_comments.maxSpikes: unstable when loss_spikes or grad_norm_spikes exceeds this count.
_comments.maxTailCv: unstable when tail_cv (std / mean of the tail window) exceeds this value.
_comments.overfitEpochs: overfit_risk when the final train/epochs exceeds this value and the loss is still converging.
_comments.dataloaderBoundRatio: dataloader_bound when the median of train/dataloading_s / train/update_s exceeds this value.
_comments.gpuMemoryHeadroomPercent: gpu_memory_headroom when the maximum of system/gpu_0_memory_usage_percentage is below this value. Not attached when train/loss has no recorded point.
_comments.gpuMemoryTightPercent: gpu_memory_tight when the maximum of system/gpu_0_memory_usage_percentage exceeds this value. Not attached when train/loss has no recorded point.
